scope: Non-UEFA continental access lists: which domestic results earn a berth in which continental competition, at which entry round. One representative season per confederation (2026 for CONMEBOL/CONCACAF/OFC, 2026-27 for AFC/CAF).

competitions.name: AFC Challenge League
competitions.clubs_note: third tier; its winner is promoted into the next ACL Two group stage

confederations.allocation_rule: Slots are not fixed per country: they follow the AFC Club Competitions Ranking, recomputed after the previous season, split into a West and an East region. The top association in each region gets 4 league-stage + 1 play-off berth, and the scale steps down from there. ACL Two slots come from the same ranking with a separate, flatter scale. The winner of ACL Two is promoted into the next ACL Elite play-off; the winner of the Challenge League into the next ACL Two group stage.

Country-level domestic-result mapping is what each association nominated for 2026-27; the AFC regulations leave the domestic selection rule to the member association.

competitions.name: CAF Champions League
competitions.clubs_note: 61 entered from 48 associations; 16 reach the group stage

competitions.name: CAF Confederation Cup
competitions.clubs_note: 56 entered from 44 associations; 16 reach the group stage

confederations.allocation_rule: One berth for every member association that enters, plus a second berth for the 12 highest-ranked associations in the CAF 5-year ranking. The reigning Champions League holder is also entitled to enter, but no association may be represented by more than two clubs, so the holder only adds a berth if its own association has room. Theoretical maximum 68 clubs; the quota is a flat 1-or-2 per country, not a sliding scale.

confederation_cup.note: Egypt Cup runners-up, because the cup winners were already Champions League-qualified

single_berth_pattern.confederation_cup: usually the national cup winner; the remaining associations field one club of their choosing
single_berth_pattern.quote: Associations are shown according to their CAF 5-year ranking

confederations.drop_down_note: None. Both competitions are closed ladders: 61 CL entrants play two knockout rounds down to 16 group-stage clubs, and 56 Confederation Cup entrants do the same. No Champions League loser is transferred to the Confederation Cup in 2026-27 (the same was true in 2025-26). Do not model a drop-down for CAF.

competitions.name: CONCACAF Champions Cup
competitions.clubs_note: 10 associations; 5 byes to the round of 16, 22 into round one

confederations.allocation_rule: A fixed quota by zone and by qualifying competition, not an association ranking. The North American Zone gets 18 berths split Mexico 6 / USA 8 / Canada 4; the Central American Zone 6; the Caribbean Zone 3. 12 of the 27 berths come from three international competitions (Leagues Cup, Caribbean Cup, Central American Cup), so a country's total is not a pure league quota.

champions_cup.note: Apertura/Clausura champion with the better aggregate; bye to the round of 16
bye; the Leagues Cup berth is not tied to a league
Canadian MLS clubs compete for the US-side MLS berths

confederations.drop_down_note: None. Single-elimination bracket: round-one losers are out, there is no secondary CONCACAF club competition to fall into.

qualifying_window.note: round one 3-4 and 17-19 Feb / 10-12 and 24-26 Feb; round of 16 10-19 Mar; final 30 May 2026

confederations.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_CONCACAF_Champions_Cup citing https://www.concacaf.com/champions-cup/news/2026-concacaf-champions-cup-key-details/ and the 2026 CONCACAF Champions Cup regulations
confederations.quote: Twenty-seven teams qualified for the tournament, with five qualifying directly to the round of 16. The remaining 22 teams entered in round one. In addition to national league competitions in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, 12 of 27 berths were determined by international competitions, including the 2025 Leagues Cup (three), 2025 CONCACAF Caribbean Cup (three), and 2025 CONCACAF Central American Cup (six).
notes: Leagues Cup nominally supplies 3 berths (champion, runner-up, third place); the 2026 team list contains only 2 (Seattle as champion, LA Galaxy as third place), so one berth was absorbed. Verify the Leagues Cup line each season.
Round one is two-legged; the round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals and final are also two-legged, with the final a single match.

competitions.name: OFC Men's Champions League
competitions.clubs_note: 8 in the group stage: 7 direct + 1 qualifying-stage winner

confederations.allocation_rule: Exactly one berth per member association, for all 11 associations. There is no ranking and no second berth. Seven associations enter the group stage directly and four play a qualifying stage for the last group-stage place.
confederations.drop_down_note: None. One competition, single bracket; qualifying-stage losers are out.

qualifying_window.note: qualifying stage in Samoa; competition proper 9-22 Aug 2026 in Fiji

confederations.quote: A total of 11 teams from all 11 OFC member associations may enter the competition. Seven associations (Fiji, New Caledonia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands, Tahiti, Vanuatu) are awarded one berth each in the group stage. Four associations (American Samoa, Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga) are awarded one berth each in the qualifying stage, with the winners advancing to the group stage.
notes: From 2026 the OFC Champions League winner no longer takes the FIFA Club World Cup / Intercontinental Cup berth; the OFC Professional League champion does. Do not link the two.

simple_note: CONMEBOL, CAF, CONCACAF and OFC all use flat fixed quotas (CONMEBOL 7/6/4, CAF 1-or-2 per member, CONCACAF fixed by zone, OFC 1 per member). AFC is the only one of the five that allocates by an association ranking, and the only one with a genuine two-tier drop-down ladder.
gaps: AFC per-country domestic-result mapping is the 2026-27 nomination, not a regulation; associations may change which domestic competition supplies which berth.

CAF single-berth associations mostly send their cup winner to the Confederation Cup, but several sent a league placing or a cup runner-up in 2026-27. Treat that slot as 'one club of the association's choosing'.
CONCACAF Leagues Cup berth count differs between the published distribution (3) and the 2026 team list (2) — marked medium confidence on that single line.
